svg.desc: Era II Helsinki: corridors that carry service, real HSL rail geometry and stops, and the city's sub-district names, with an information column giving counts, services, provenance and known gaps.
svg.text: Tullinpuomi – Postipuisto – Kalasatama – Kaivopuisto · live-feed era

A D E I K L P R T U X Y Z
WHAT THIS MAP DOES NOT KNOW
· NO WATER — the biggest hole, because the coastline is what
carries Helsinki’s silhouette. Every OSM source is refused by
this environment’s egress policy. §11.2 has the query;
· L0 is corridors that carry service, NOT a street map. Any
street with no route on it is absent.
· Feed is 2022-02-22. Tram 13 opened 12 Aug 2024 through
Kalasatama and Vallilanlaakso and is not in it.
· No anchors, sites or edges: the Era II extent has real
geometry and nothing authored on it yet. Orientation is the
· Colour is by MODE here, which is HSL’s own rule — 27
services is past what any palette survives.
